content.title: Can-Fite BioPharma Secures Australian Patent for Obesity Drug
content.summary: Can-Fite BioPharma (CANF) has released an update. Can-Fite BioPharma Ltd. has received a patent allowance in Australia for its oral anti-obesity drug Namodenoson, which has demonstrated a promising safety profile. The patent, valid until 2040, covers methods of treating obesity by increasing adiponectin hormone levels to reduce body fat.
